author: codex
description: Add update-existing mode to the email/name CSV importer, retaining skip as the default. Return created, updated and skipped counts and provide a summary for the admin console.

defects.mechanism: Update mode selects globally by email even though Users.find scopes identities by company. An import can overwrite a user belonging to another company.
The update patch initializes the persisted role to member although the CSV only owns email and name. Existing administrators lose authorization after a profile import.
